page_data.en:
At 5 p.m. 9-9-40, information was received
by D.I. Tabrum to the effect that a detective of
the S.C.G.P.B. had been murdered on Avenue Haig.
Enquiries were made by the undersigned at No.
13 Jessfield Road where this fact was verified.
Later the following particulars were obtained
by the undersigned.
The deceased was:
LIEN TSUNG MING (刘震民), 25, Anhwei,
a detective of the Ziccawei Station,
S.C.G.P.B.
At about 2.30 p.m. 9-9-40, he was riding in
a ricksha from East Pah Jah Village along a lane
leading to Avenue Haig.
When the ricksha reached Avenue Haig and turned
North a single shot was fired by some unknown
person, the bullet penetrating the back of the above
named's head, causing, it is believed, instant
death.
The ricksha puller, took the explosion for the
sound of a burst tyre and continued on his way,
whilst the assailant made his escape unobserved.
At the corner of Avenue Haig and Edinburgh Road
a S.C.G.P.B. Constable on Traffic duty, noticed
unnatural position of the passenger in the ricksha,
stopped the vehicle and found Lien Tsung Ming to
be dead.
The body was then in the same ricksha transported
to a sub-station of the S.C.G.P.B.
A party of Japanese Gendarmerie accompanied
by Officers of S.C.G.P.B. then proceeded to the
scene of shooting and conducted investigation the
page_data.zh:
1940年9月9日下午5时，塔布鲁姆 (Tabrum) 督察收到情报，
称一名法租界公董局警务处 (S.C.G.P.B.) 的侦探
在海格路 (Avenue Haig) 被谋杀。
具名人在杰斯菲尔德路 (Jessfield Road) 13号
进行了查询，证实了这一事实。
随后，具名人获得了以下详情。
死者为：
刘震民 (LIEN TSUNG MING)，25岁，安徽人，
系法租界公董局警务处 (S.C.G.P.B.) 徐家汇巡捕房
的一名侦探。
1940年9月9日下午2时30分左右，他乘坐
人力车从东巴贾村 (East Pah Jah Village) 沿一条
通往海格路的小巷行驶。
当人力车到达海格路并向北转弯时，
某不明身份者开了一枪，子弹穿透上述人员
的后脑，据信导致其当场死亡。
人力车夫将枪声误认为是轮胎爆裂声，继续前行，
而袭击者则趁人不备逃脱。
在海格路与爱丁堡路 (Edinburgh Road) 的拐角处，
一名正在执行交通任务的法租界公董局警务处巡捕，
注意到人力车乘客姿势异常，
拦停车辆后发现刘震民 (Lien Tsung Ming) 已死亡。
尸体随后由同一辆人力车运至
法租界公董局警务处的一个分巡捕房。
一队日本宪兵在法租界公董局警务处警官的陪同下
前往枪击现场并进行了调查，其
